Together with a League of Heroes, they have turned a fractured world into a seamless utopia where crime is systematically dismantled. Meanwhile, at Wayne Manor, a brilliant family of rescued children thrives under the care of the world’s most celebrated power couple: Bruce Wayne and Clark Kent. From university professors and ballerinas to a new generation of cooperative heroes, the Kent-Wayne legacy stands as a monument to absolute safety, unity, and domestic bliss.  But a perfect world is never built by accident. Beneath the surface of this frictionless paradise lies an elite operation that leaves no stone unturned to guarantee global stability. It is a world where veteran protectors can finally hang up their capes with a contented sigh, knowing a disciplined younger generation is ready to take to the sky—all while the dark secret of the true price paid for this peace fades silently into history.
